title: 20 Years After Its Own Outbreak, an Ugandan Town Beats Back Ebola
summary_full: The Bundibugyo Ebola virus takes its name from this small town, where it was first discovered in 2007. Now, the species has returned to eastern Congo, halting life on a busy border.
